answer: Admit newcomers in cohorts of 25, not one by one. Each member locks a $120 bond and files 10 verified jobs in 30 days. Cohort mates audit every job against a shared kernel record, and a violet seal marks each pass. Two failed audits burn the bond, eject the member, and freeze the whole cohort for 14 days. Forging 1,000 identities costs $120,000 in bonds plus 10,000 real jobs, about 2,500 hours of work, and 40 weekly intake windows, ten months at the very best. A lone fake slips past one gatekeeper, but a willow hedge shows a rotten root to the whole row at once.
